She smiles with her mouth closed and looks at the girl on the right. She holds a white plate with a strawberry shortcake on it. name: single_object
prompt: One adult girl is alone inside a library during the day. The image is an upper body view at a straight-on angle. Behind her are a bookshelf, a stack of books, a wooden ladder and a desk lamp. An arched window appears in the background and there is sunlight with visible light rays. The lighting is warm and the background is blurred. A globe, curtains, a wooden table, an armchair, a potted plant and a railing on an upper level also appear in the background. She has long wavy brown hair that falls over her shoulder and a single ahoge on top of her head. Her bangs are swept to the side and sidelocks hang beside her face. A blue ribbon is tied in her hair. Her half-closed green eyes have long eyelashes and sit under thick eyebrows. She wears eyeshadow and the visible parts of her cheeks are blushing. She tilts her head and looks at the viewer. She wears pearl earrings. She wears an open beige cardigan with long sleeves over a white blouse. The blouse has a frilled collar and lace trim at the cuffs. She wears a brooch. Her nails are painted pink and she wears a ring and a wristwatch. She holds a closed red book and a green bookmark ribbon hangs from between its pages. She grips the left and right sides of the book with both hands. The blank front cover faces the viewer. The top edge of the book sits just below the bridge of her nose and covers her mouth and the lower half of her face.

name: still_life
prompt: This is an oil painting of a still life with no people. The scene is indoors during the day and is viewed straight on. A wooden table shows visible wood grain. A beige cloth lies on the table under a stack of three books. The green book is at the bottom with the blue book in the middle and the brown book on top. A white vase stands on the brown book and holds sunflowers and daisies with green leaves. Scattered petals and a bundle of lavender lie on the table. A red apple sits in front of the stack and hides the lower edge of the green book. A pear sits behind the stack and is partly hidden by it. A green apple, purple grapes, a lemon, a fig and a walnut also lie on the table. A teacup of steaming tea rests on a saucer that also holds a teaspoon. An unlit candle with wax drips stands in a brass candlestand. A pair of unworn glasses and a pocket watch on a gold chain lie on the table. A quill and an inkwell sit on the table. A blank envelope is closed with a wax seal. A key and a seashell lie on the table. A green bottle is stopped with a cork. A wine glass stands on the table. The background shows a beige wall and a window with white curtains. Soft sunlight lights the scene and the objects cast shadows. The background is blurred.
